body: I'm still a little unsure about making changes here that don't match anyone their model. But I guess none of it was well-defined to begin with...

Changes look good.

Error events for `<script>`s moved between documents during failing fetch might remain a minor issue (Chromium will stay spec-inconformant at least for a couple of releases), but I don't think this is blocking.
Content scripts which are from extension are getting blocked if they are specified to run at document start. What can we do to execute the content scripts at document start from extension.

LGTM.

According to the latest run of https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/19632, the behavior diffs of current browsers are (after-prepare* cases):

- Firefox and Safari fires script or window error events
- Safari evaluates classic scripts
